lines: 1,357 incidents were reported in Chennai district (last 7 days), 6% more than the previous period.
1,167 incidents are still open, 505 of them past the deadline; 65 severe events.
46 incidents came from more than one source, and 73 incidents appear only in the news.

Canal overflow at Ice House, Teynampet., Teynampet: Still open at more than twice its 6-hour deadline
Canal overflow at Kilpauk, Anna Nagar., Anna Nagar: Still open at more than twice its 6-hour deadline
Canal overflow at Gangai Nagar, Ambattur., Ambattur: Still open at more than twice its 6-hour deadline
